title: Nice
body:
The simplicity makes it the best tasks app, but one crucial thing is lacking - why do the tasks disappear right away when finished? 

At the end of the day the most rewarding thing (that basically all other apps have except for this one) is that I can see what I was able to do that day. The finished tasks should be marked, but should disappear at midnight, not right away. 

Is there a possibility that the dev team will implement this?

title: Little to no customizations
body:
The app is very rigid and allows little to no customizations. There is no option to view tasks for given dates (such as ‘today’), add labels to them or filter them in any other way than by already assigned lists.
Something I’ve been searching for since forever is a to-do app integrated with calendar in a way that it offers an option to assign tasks to certain events. Google Tasks doesn’t do that, but I’m using it because of its calendar.

title: I recommend.
body:
Hey Google 

For me, this is the best task list app. Simplicity is its strength. 

Please kindly add to the app the possibility to work without logging into your Google account. As a user I want to have the choice to work as an unsubscribe or logged in when I need to synchronize (this also applies to other applications such as Google Keep or Google Podcasts, which are also very good). 

Please also for users, 
who will be logged into the account and synchronize their private stuff add real encryption on the zero knowledge user side of the device. We want our task lists or notes etc. to be just for the eyes of their owners. You are a company that knows how important privacy is.
